name: vnc
title: VNC Desktop Server
description: Run a VNC server on a headless Linux host: install x11vnc/Xvfb, start a display with a window manager and password, check status, grab screenshots.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: VNC 远程桌面
zh-CN.description: 在无头 Linux 主机上运行 VNC：安装 x11vnc/Xvfb，带窗口管理器和密码启动显示器，查看状态，截取屏幕。

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install x11vnc, Xvfb, fluxbox, x11-utils and imagemagick via apt

tools.name: start
tools.description: Ensure the display exists (Xvfb if needed) and serve it over VNC

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop the VNC server on a display, optionally the Xvfb behind it

tools.name: status
tools.description: List displays with X server, geometry, window manager, VNC port and pid

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Grab the current display contents to a PNG

tools.name: logs
tools.description: Tail the x11vnc log for a display
